mapper.select: select activity.id, activity."name", activity.category, activity.venue, activity.price, activity.description, seat.id as seat_id, seat.seat_rows, split_part(seat.id, '-', 1) AS "column", split_part(seat.id, '-', 2) AS "row", activity_image.content_type, activity_image.image_data from "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity LEFT JOIN "interviewworks_ticket".seat seat ON activity.id = seat.activity_id inner JOIN "interviewworks_ticket".activity_image activity_image ON activity_image.activity_uuid = activity.activity_uuid order by activity.id

select activity.id, activity."name", activity.category, activity.venue, activity.price, activity.description, seat.id as seat_id, seat.seat_rows, split_part(seat.id, '-', 1) AS "column", split_part(seat.id, '-', 2) AS "row", activity_image.content_type, activity_image.image_data from "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity LEFT JOIN "interviewworks_ticket".seat seat ON activity.id = seat.activity_id inner JOIN "interviewworks_ticket".activity_image activity_image ON activity_image.activity_uuid = activity.activity_uuid WHERE activity.id = #{id} order by activity.id

select "session".id, "session".activity_id, activity."name", "session"."date", "session"."time", "session".salesdate, "session".salestime, "session".capacity, "session".reserved, "session".sold, "session".status from "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" inner join "interviewworks_ticket".activity activity on "session".activity_id = activity.id order by "session".id

select ticket.orderno, ticket."name", ticket."time", ticket."date", ticket."time", ticket.status, ticket.price from "interviewworks_ticket".ticket ticket order by ticket.created_date, ticket.updated_date

WITH next_activity AS ( INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket".activity_sequence ( activity_date, current_no ) SELECT CURRENT_DATE, 1 WHERE #{id} IS NULL OR #{id} = '' ON CONFLICT (activity_date) DO UPDATE SET current_no = "interviewworks_ticket".activity_sequence.current_no + 1 RETURNING 'ACT' || '-' || TO_CHAR(activity_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(current_no::TEXT, 3, '0') AS id ), activity_id AS ( SELECT #{id} AS id WHERE #{id} IS NOT NULL AND #{id} != '' UNION ALL SELECT id FROM next_activity ) INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" ( id, "name", category, venue, price, description ) SELECT activity_id.id, #{name}, #{category}, #{venue}, #{price}, #{description} FROM activity_id ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET "name" = EXCLUDED."name", category = EXCLUDED.category, venue = EXCLUDED.venue, price = EXCLUDED.price, description = EXCLUDED.description RETURNING id AS activity_id, activity_uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket".activity_image (activity_uuid, filename, content_type, width, height, image_data) VALUES (#{activity_uuid}, #{filename}, 'image/jpeg', #{width}, #{height}, #{image_data}) ON CONFLICT (activity_uuid) DO UPDATE SET filename = EXCLUDED.filename, content_type = EXCLUDED.content_type, width = EXCLUDED.width, height = EXCLUDED.height, image_data = EXCLUDED.image_data
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM "interviewworks_ticket".activity_image WHERE activity_uuid = ( SELECT activity_uuid FROM "interviewworks_ticket".activity WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" WHERE "session".activity_id = activity.id ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket"."seat" ( id, activity_id, seat_rows, seats_per_row ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{activity_id}, #{seat_rows}, #{seats_per_row} ) ON CONFLICT (id, activity_id) DO UPDATE SET seat_rows = EXCLUDED.seat_rows, seats_per_row = EXCLUDED.seats_per_row
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM "interviewworks_ticket".activity activity WHERE activity.id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" WHERE "session".activity_id = activity.id )
mapper.select: WITH next_session AS ( INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket".session_sequence ( session_date, current_no ) SELECT CURRENT_DATE, 1 WHERE #{id} IS NULL OR #{id} = '' ON CONFLICT (session_date) DO UPDATE SET current_no = "interviewworks_ticket".session_sequence.current_no + 1 RETURNING 'S' || '-' || TO_CHAR(session_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(current_no::TEXT, 3, '0') AS id ), session_id AS ( SELECT #{id} AS id WHERE #{id} IS NOT NULL AND #{id} != '' UNION ALL SELECT id FROM next_session ) INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket"."session" ( id, activity_id, "date", "time", salesdate, salestime, capacity, sold, status ) SELECT session_id.id, #{activity_id}, #{date}, #{time}, #{salesdate}, #{salestime}, #{capacity}, 0, #{status} FROM session_id ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET activity_id = EXCLUDED.activity_id, "date" = EXCLUDED."date", "time" = EXCLUDED."time", salesdate = EXCLUDED.salesdate, salestime = EXCLUDED.salestime, capacity = EXCLUDED.capacity, status = EXCLUDED.status RETURNING id
select seat.id, seat.activity_id, seat.seat_rows, seat.seats_per_row from "interviewworks_ticket".seat seat where seat.activity_id = #{activity_id}
